'''Hunter-seeker missiles''' were a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]].<ref name="RPG-Core" /> The [[E522 assassin droid/Legends|E522 assassin droid]] was equipped with a [[Hunter-seeker Projectile Cannon|projectile cannon]]<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> that was loaded with a magazine of six hunter-seeker missiles.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
